items.ai_summary: Dune launched real-time onchain market data feeds covering over 200 trading venues across 12 blockchains, delivering trade data about one second after execution for institutional clients.
items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

metadata.background_en: The market for tokenized stocks has grown sharply over the past year: RWA.xyz data cited by the report puts distributed value at $3.58 billion, up from about $627 million a year earlier, a roughly 470% increase. Fragmentation and issuer pushback have accompanied that growth — OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange announced plans on Oct. 4 for a tokenized stock trading platform through their OKXICE joint venture, and 16 companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs have since filed objections to having their shares traded there, without specifying reasons. In May, Tiger Research director Ryan Yoon warned that trading the same tokenized stocks across multiple blockchains could create price discrepancies, increase slippage and reduce market efficiency.
metadata.background_zh: 过去一年，代币化股票市场大幅增长：报道援引 RWA.xyz 的数据称，其分布式价值已达 35.8 亿美元，高于一年前的约 6.27 亿美元，增幅约 470%。伴随增长的是市场碎片化和发行方的反对——OKX 与纽交所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）于 10 月 4 日宣布通过双方合资的 OKXICE 建设代币化股票交易平台，此后包括微软、Alphabet 和高盛在内的 16 家公司提交反对意见，但未说明理由。今年 5 月，Tiger Research 总监 Ryan Yoon 曾警告，同一代币化股票在多个区块链平台交易可能造成价格差异、 slippage 上升并降低市场效率。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Dune announced on Thursday that it has launched real-time market data feeds covering more than 200 onchain trading venues across 12 blockchains, including Ethereum, Solana, Base and XLayer, delivering trade data roughly one second after execution. The feeds cover spot trading on decentralized exchanges as well as perpetual futures on Hyperliquid and Lighter, with standardized data on prices, trade sizes and transaction details.

Dune co-founder and CEO Fredrik Haga said most institutions are watching onchain markets first because "they can't price these assets properly without them anymore," pointing to market data as the entry point for institutional onchain participation. The launch comes as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.

Haga said quant funds, market makers, asset managers and bank trading desks are among the first clients, but declined to identify them, citing nondisclosure agreements. According to Dune, these firms use the data to assess liquidity, compare prices across venues and evaluate trading strategies before committing capital.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Dune 于周四宣布推出实时市场数据源，覆盖以太坊、Solana、Base 和 XLayer 等 12 条区块链上的 200 多个链上交易场所，交易数据在成交后约一秒即可提供。该数据源覆盖去中心化交易所的现货交易，以及 Hyperliquid 和 Lighter 上的永续合约交易，并以标准化格式提供价格、成交规模和交易明细数据。

Dune 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Fredrik Haga 表示，多数机构首先关注链上市场，因为"没有这些数据，他们已经无法为这些资产正确定价"，意指市场数据是机构参与链上市场的入口。此次发布正值代币化股票市场快速扩张并面临日益严格审视之际。

Haga 表示，首批客户包括量化基金、做市商、资产管理机构和银行交易台，但以保密协议为由拒绝透露具体名称。据 Dune 介绍，这些机构使用该数据评估流动性、比较不同场所的价格，并在投入资金前评估交易策略。
metadata.market_impact_en: The feeds give institutional desks standardized, near-real-time pricing across DEX spot venues and perpetual futures platforms such as Hyperliquid and Lighter, lowering the data-integration barrier that currently sits between traditional trading systems and onchain execution. Over time that channel could affect liquidity and market-making depth on the covered venues, and it links tokenized-equity pricing debates to onchain market-data infrastructure.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该数据源为机构交易台提供跨去中心化现货场所及 Hyperliquid、Lighter 等永续合约平台的标准化近实时价格，降低了目前横亘在传统交易系统与链上执行之间的数据接入门槛。这一渠道随时间可能影响被覆盖场所的流动性与做市深度，并将代币化股票的定价争议与链上市场数据基础设施联系起来。

items.ai_summary: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming a16z Crypto to a16z Frontier, broadening the fund's remit to AI and other long-horizon technologies under Chris Dixon, Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin and Guy Wuollet, while keeping its crypto investments and regulatory advocacy.
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.background_en: a16z's disclosed crypto bets include Coinbase, the Solana blockchain and Uniswap. In January the firm said it had raised more than $15 billion across its funds, and co-founder Ben Horowitz wrote that the mission "starts with winning the key architectures of the future—AI and crypto." Dixon has said long-horizon investing has been his focus since joining a16z in 2013, a theme that led to investments in Oculus and drone startups such as Skydio and Zipline.
metadata.background_zh: a16z 已披露的加密投资包括 Coinbase、Solana 区块链和 Uniswap。今年 1 月，该公司表示其各只基金合计募资超过 150 亿美元，联合创始人 Ben Horowitz 在公司文章中称，使命“始于赢得未来的关键架构——AI 与加密”。Dixon 表示，自 2013 年加入 a16z 以来，长周期投资一直是他的重点，这一主题带来了对 Oculus 以及 Skydio、Zipline 等无人机初创公司的投资。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund "a16z Crypto" to "a16z Frontier," widening its mandate to AI, biology, hardware and other long-horizon technologies while saying it will keep investing in crypto and advocating for crypto regulation. The change was disclosed in an email to the firm's newsletter subscribers on Thursday, with Chris Dixon leading the fund alongside Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin and Guy Wuollet.

a16z is among the largest backers of the crypto industry, and as the report frames it, a firm of that size dropping "crypto" from its name shows where it may expect the next wave of capital to go.

The firm calls the move "an expansion" and says crypto stays: "we will continue to invest in crypto and related ventures and advocate for sensible crypto regulation." The post gave no size for the renamed fund; the latest figure on record is the $2.2 billion announced in May.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
安德森·霍洛维茨（Andreessen Horowitz，简称 a16z）将其加密基金“a16z Crypto”更名为“a16z Frontier”，把投资范围扩大到人工智能、生物、硬件等长周期技术领域，同时表示将继续投资加密项目并推动加密监管倡导。该变动于周四通过发送给公司新闻邮件订阅者的邮件公布，基金由 Chris Dixon 与 Marc Andreessen、Ben Horowitz、Eddy Lazzarin 和 Guy Wuollet 共同领导。

a16z 是加密行业最大的投资方之一；按报道的说法，这样规模的机构把“crypto”从名称中去掉，显示出它预期下一波资金可能流向何处。

a16z 称此举是“一次扩展”，并强调加密业务保留：“我们将继续投资加密及相关项目，并倡导合理的加密监管。”相关文章未披露更名后基金的规模，公开记录中的最新数字是 5 月宣布的 22 亿美元。
metadata.market_impact_en: The rename does not itself move capital or liquidity; its transmission path runs through crypto venture-funding sentiment and narrative, with a16z's retained crypto holdings (Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap among disclosed bets) and its regulatory advocacy remaining the direct points of exposure. Any tilt of capital toward AI and frontier tech would surface first in future funding rounds rather than in spot markets.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 更名本身不会直接改变资金或流动性，其传导路径主要落在加密风险投资的情绪与叙事层面：a16z 保留的加密持仓（已披露的包括 Coinbase、Solana 和 Uniswap）及其监管倡导，是直接的风险敞口所在。若资金向 AI 与前沿科技倾斜，更可能先体现在后续融资轮次中，而非现货市场。
